segments.speaker: Rep. Crispin Diego D. Remulla
segments.text: Madam Speaker, the parliamentary status of House Bill No. 10858 is that it is in the period of sponsorship and debate. I now move to consider the proposed budget of the Metro Manila Development Authority.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Is there any objection? The Chair hears none. The motion is approved.

segments.speaker: Rep. Crispin Diego D. Remulla
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Vice Chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Crispin Diego D. Remulla
segments.text: Representative Monique Yasmine Maria Q. Lagdameo, 1st District of Makati,

segments.speaker: Rep. Crispin Diego D. Remulla

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Is there any objection? The Chair hears none.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Representative Vice Chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations, Monique Lagdameo,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: and Vice Chairperson Queenie Gonzalez are now recognized to begin the sponsorship of House Bill No. 10858.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: Good morning, Madam Speaker and distinguished members of this August Chamber.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: We are honored to sponsor today the proposed budget of the Metropolitan Manila

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: Development Authority, or the MMDA, for the fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: The State recognizes Metro Manila as a special development and administrative region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: By reason of the complex and interrelated challenges of rapid urbanization in Metro Manila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: such as those relating to traffic management, solid waste disposal, flood mitigation and sewerage management,

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: urban renewal, health and sanitation, and public safety, the MMDA was established under RA No. 7924,

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: with a mandate, among other things, to formulate, coordinate, regulate, and monitor the implementation of medium and long-term plans and programs for the delivery of Metro-wide services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: It works in close partnership with the 17 local governments to develop and implement integrated, sustainable, and resilient metropolitan development strategies for Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: Under House Bill No. 10858, or General Appropriations Bill for Fiscal Year 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: the MMDA seeks the approval of its proposed national subsidy in the amount of Php 6,560,912,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: This allocation will provide the MMDA with the means and resources necessary to fulfill its mandate

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: and fund and implement its core programs on solid waste and disposal management,

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: traffic and transport management, flood mitigation and sewerage management,

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: Pasig River Ferry Service and MMDA Roadside Management Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: essential to the millions of Filipinos who live, work, and travel throughout Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: In view of the foregoing, I respectfully urge my esteemed colleagues to support the immediate approval of the proposed budget of the MMDA for Fiscal Year 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Monique Yazmin Maria Q. Lagdameo
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Speaker, and we are now ready to entertain questions from the floor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At dahil doon, napapahiya. Di ba? Na hindi naman necessary.

segments.text: Ang sinasabi ng iba, may paglabag, sitahin mo, bigyan mo ng ticket, tapos na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi yung sitahin mo, bigyan mo ng ticket, gagawing kang content,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: papapanood ka ng milyong-milyong tao habang pinapangaralan ka

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: at minsan, in a humiliating manner.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Therefore, ang issue po natin dito, yung social media policy ng MMDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At yun nga, kaya tayo nag-interpolate dahil confusing po yung public statements ng MMDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: institutional practice naman po ng MMDA, yung kailangan din sila mag-recording for,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: may record sila ng traffic law enforcement, traffic monitoring,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: ginagawa naman po nila rin for record purposes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: However, minsan talaga nag-go-go over, beyond doon, dahil sinishare ng iba,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: in this case, si Clearing Ops, Gabriel Goh, maaaring na ilagay niya yun sa kanyang personal vlog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Dito ho, again, nandito ho siya iniimbestigahan ngayon, tinitingnan nga po kung maaaring lumabag ho siya doon sa data privacy law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi po ba the previous year, nagkaroon na po ng insidente involving Goh?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po ba na merong ganong insidente?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And after that, may pahayag po si Chairman Artes na nakikita ko dyan, sabi niya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: may policy na raw ang MMDA, bawal!

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Could we clarify from the MMDA, ano ba yung exactly yung in-issue nila na policy after that 2025 incident?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Your Honor, institutional recording po sana yung ginawa, for recording purposes po ng MMDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: So, gaya po nang sinabi ko, kasalukuyan po siyang iniimbestigahan ngayon, kung posibleng nga meron siyang, he went overboard in that aspect po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Kaya, kung meron man siyang violation sa data privacy, yun po yung, we are still awaiting that investigation as of now, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In a press conference, ito po sinabi niya, quote, ipagbabawal natin yung mga personal posts about operations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: MMDA na lang magpopost ng clearing operations natin, whether pictures or video.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Photos and videos of operations shall be posted by its public...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Public Information Office via Facebook, X, Instagram, etc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sabi niya, napirman ko na actually yung regulation regarding pagpopost ng actual na trabaho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano po yung regulation na binabanggit ni Chairman Artes?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Your Honor, yun po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Kung, inaalam po ngayon kung kunyari may paglabas...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yes, ma'am. Tinatanong lang kung ano yung written regulation, official regulation on social media posting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Ang pinagbabawal na po ngayon yung pag-share po ng institutional na video.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Sorry. Yun po pala yung pwede. Yung pag-share po ng institutional.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Ang hindi po po pwede, yung sa personal po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Anong gusto po natin malaman, kasi hindi po easily available or accessible,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: halimbawa sa MMDA website, yung exact memorandum or order containing this policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Para malinaw po. Ano po yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, MMDA will furnish you today...

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: ...with a complete and a complete copy po of that direct...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: And also the show-cause order po of...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Thank you. We would appreciate that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ngayon, okay. So mukhang meron ng standing policy na ganon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero, days after the incident, certain MMDA officials made seemingly contradictory statements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: MMDA General Manager, General Manager niyo po, Nicolás Torre III,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: mentioned a no-restriction policy to prevent personal blogging using MMDA footage.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: As long as there's no law being violated, wala kaming restriction na hard and fast rule

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: na ibigay sa mga tao namin na pigilan na huwag niyong i-post ang mga bagay na ginagawa niyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi namin pwedeng gawin kasi part ng trabaho ng MMDA is to educate the people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mas marami kaming maririch na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mas marami kaming maririch na ito pala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pag hindi ka nag-helmet, e, violation yan. Ticket mo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, batay sa statement ng General Manager sa publiko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Eh, sinasabi niya, walang restriction. Pwede namang i-post.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, yun po, kaya po medyo nalilito tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Miss Distinguished Colleague, we will be honest, MMDA will be honest,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: bago lang ho si General Manager Torre.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: So, hindi ho siya possibly aware.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Doon sa rule po na yan ng MMDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: But we will remind him kapag, and all his employees, kapag kung bumalik man siya after his leave.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: However, aside from General Manager Torre, si Chairman Artes din po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: meron din mga statement to the effect na after the incident,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: hindi naman bawal kumuha ng footage in public.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, this was in defense or in reaction to the allegation na

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: binayulate niyo yung data privacy right ng individual.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, could that be explained? Anong explanation po noon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Ang, your honor, ang sinabi po ni Chairman, hindi po bawal kumuha kung public place.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Pero yung pagpo-post po is another matter entirely.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Kaya po, nagkakonsult po sila sa Data Privacy Commission ngayon dahil sa mga ganyang mga insidente po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Now, so, malinaw ang policy mula 2025 na hindi pwede yung personal vlogging of official MMDA operations, tama po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, yung kalakaran ni Mr. Goh na nakikita natin na habang nagkakonsult,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: nag-operation siya, meron pang parang private individual yun na sumusunod sa kanya at nag-be-video.

segments.text: So naayos na po ba ito sa ngayon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At nakarating po ba sa office ng ating Director General?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Nakarating na po yung mga gantong reports sa ating Bureau of Corrections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: They're inaayos na po nila yung ganitong mga sistema

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: at pinapabalik na po sa normal na withdrawal po yung ating mga PDLs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maasahan po ba natin, Madam Speaker, na sa linggong ito, maaayos na po

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung sistema na ito ng withdrawal?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Yes po. The Bureau of Corrections are guaranteeing that they will go back to the standard system po ng ating withdrawal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Magandang balita po na bababalik na yung dating sistema ng withdrawal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero mas magandang balita po sana kung magkakaroon na ng update tungkol naman doon sa restoration

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng nawawala na pera sa PDL Trust Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron na po ba kayong petsa

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kung kailan ito matitiyak na maibabalik?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, may update po ngayong araw. As we are informed, meron pong confiscated na pera ang BuCor, about 6 million in confiscated money na pinag-aaralan po nila na baka po pwedeng iyon yung gamitin to revert.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Kung yun po yung pwedeng gamitin na maipangbayad sa mga nawawalan po ng amount

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: kasi wala pong nagkiklaim nung confiscated money na yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: So sa ngayon po, undergoing legal study po yung paggamit po nung pera ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dapat talaga maimbestigahan po yan, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kasi nakakahinala naman po na may biglang sumulpot na ganyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Napaka-init po ng issue na ito na nananawagan po tayo ng patas na investigasyon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng malinaw na sistema at may malinaw na mananagot kapag may ganitong tipo ng mga issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Chair, nanggaling din po sa ating plenary deliberations ang Commission on Human Rights

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at nagbigay po sila ng update tungkol dito sa nawawalang pondo sa Trust Fund sa CIW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na ilang beses daw po sila na nagtangka po at nagplano na bumisita sa CIW

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para mag-conduct ng kanilang independent investigation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit ang kanila pong ulat ay hindi po sila pinapapasok sa CIW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maari bang magbigay ng paglilinaw ang ating distinguished sponsor tungkol dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Madam Speaker, as per sa ating Bureau of Corrections,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: may coordination naman po with CIW and the Commission on Human Rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Regarding this matter, kung nagkaproblema man daw po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: ang malaking factor po daw ay yung pagdating kung kailan po dumating ang ating mga kawanimula po

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: galing sa Commission on Human Rights. Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pwede ba natin malaman Madam Speaker kung ano po yung problema na yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi po ba pag may visitation ng CHR para mag-imbestiga tungkol sa mga potensyal na,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: paglabag sa karapatang pantao, at anytime, na dapat po payagan po sila na makapasok?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: As per our Bureau of Corrections, bandang hapon daw po dumating ang ating mga taga-CHR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Meron pong oras na sinusunod yung ating mga PDLs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: So kaya daw po, hindi po muna pinapasok ang ating mga ka-PDLs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ang kawanimula po sa Commission on Human Rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Pero ang ating pong Bureau of Corrections are willing na makipagtulungan po sa ating pong CHR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ayaw naman po nilang i-undermine yung kapangyarihan ng ating pong Commission on Human Rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Lalo na po doon sa unannounced visits sa ating pong mga penal farms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: ang request lang rin po ng Bureau of Corrections, lalo na ay yung,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: siguro may mga safeguards rin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Siyempre may security concern rin po silang,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Speaker, may kopya po tayo ng sulat ng Bucor para po sa CHR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tungkol sa request ng CHR para sa dialogue sa mga PDLs sa CIW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At may sinasabi po dito ang Bucor na,

segments.text: and let me just read this for the record.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Considering Data Privacy Act and based from the 2024 Bucor Manual,

segments.text: there is a need for the requesting party to identify specifically the name, names of PDL subject for a dialogue interview

segments.text: for us to secure the consent from the identified PDL.

segments.text: May we know the particular provision?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: In the Data Privacy Act as well as the 2024 Bucor Manual,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: which formed the basis of this particular statement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: So ang protocol daw po sa ating Bureau of Corrections is

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: kailangan po magpaalam po sa ating PDL kung gusto rin po nilang makipag-usap sa ating mga ibat-ibang gusto mag-interview po sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Pero as for kung meron pong...

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: As for yung visitation manual po nila for PDLs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: oras sa kanilang manual Wednesday to Sunday, 7 a.m. to 3 p.m. daw po

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: ang ating pong visiting hours according to the Bureau of Corrections manual po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tama po ba yung rinig ko kailangan pong magpaalam ng CHR sa Bucor

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para gawin yung kanilang constitutional duty?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Commission on Human Rights to investigate, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ang close coordination lang po with the Bucor is enough

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: because may mga security concerns nga po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: May instance nga daw po kasi na may mga po mapasok nagpapanggap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Yun po yung nabanggit po ng ating pong Director General, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat sa paglilinaw, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sana po hindi na maulit ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi lang daw po isang beses na sumubok na magbisita ang CHR,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya sana po magkaroon ng mas mahigpit na coordination

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para lamang po dun sa interest ng katotohanan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at sa interest ng pananagutan pagdating po sa napakahalaga na matter na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pwede ba natin kunin yung commitment ng Bucor

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: dahil po sa marami pang hindi nasusunod na mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dapat, no, katulad sa reporting, monitoring,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: may nakita tayong mga gaps pa sa mga proseso kung paano natin matipiyak

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng sistema na ito ay hindi po makukorup, hindi mawawala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pwede bang ma-review natin itong sistema, itong guidelines na ito tungkol sa cashless system?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Bukod dyan, Madam Speaker, maaari din na sa lalong madaling panahon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sinabi nyo nga po may development sa CIW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ay ma-restore na dun sa dating sistema muna

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: habang nag-iimbestiga kayo at habang nire-review ninyo itong cashless system.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang kinababahala ng representasyon na ito, Madam Speaker, sa CIW pa lang ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So paano po, sana naman po hindi na hindi dapat ito nangyayari

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa kahit saan nating prison and penal terms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: So they are committed to reviewing the policy on the cashless system po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Any suggestions or comments regarding that system are welcome po sa ating Bureau of Corrections

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: and they are committed na hindi na po maulit yung ganitong insidente with the Commission on Human Rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Basta ang request nga lang po, basta regarding security concern, ma-address po nilang dalawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Close coordination with the Commission on Human Rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: And nagpa-audit na rin po ang ating Bureau of Corrections regarding,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: kung may ganitong incident sa other penal firms para po maiwasan na yung ganitong mga klaseng insidente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker, at ating aabangan yung risulta ng internal audit service na yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman po, at tungkol naman po sa ibang mahalaga din na usapin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: tungkol po sa legal assistance para sa child support cases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung maari po nating matanong ang Public Attorney's Office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: how many cases for child support?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: As of now po, Madam Speaker, there is no data regarding child support cases pero parang sa VAUSI po talaga yung kanilang data.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pahingin na lang po natin yung ulat kapag nagawa na po ito ng PAO dahil kami rin po ay nagsulunsad ngayon ng Pambansang Review ng Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At marami po sa mga usapin ng mga nagiging biktima, survivors natin ay may kinalaman sa child support, kasama na ang spousal support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya nais ko rin pong magtanong, dahil ang Pilipinas po ay nag-gratify ng Convention on the International Recovery of Child Support and Other Forms of Family Maintenance,

segments.text: meron din po bang nahahawakan ng mga kaso ang PAO na may kinalaman sa demand for child support?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At family maintenance mula po sa mga Pilipinos na nagtatrabaho at nakatira overseas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago

Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Summum na po kasi yung data na yan sa BAUSI cases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: So, hindi po nila nabre-breakdown pa kung sino po yung nag-a-avail ng ganitong klaseng assistance with regard to child support in international cases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Speaker, tayo po ay mag-initiate ng dialogo sa PAO at tungkol dito at sa mga relevant agencies natin, lalo na sa Central Authority natin dito, ang DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So, para matiyak na ang mga konbensyon na kung saan tayo ay kasama, ay talagang natitiyak natin na nai-enforce, may maayos na implementasyon dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At kung meron po kayong mga pinakahuling ulat tungkol dito, ay tatanggapin po ng ating representasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Madam Speaker, pinakahuli ko po na ilalapit at ihahapag sa Department of Justice

segments.text: tungkol po sa nakalaan na 90 million pesos.

segments.text: So, ongoing po sa ngayon ang agricultural camp.

segments.text: At nananawagan din po tayo sa kapulungan na ito na agaran ng tignan yung mga naiulat sa atin na gaps sa implementation ng JJWA.

segments.text: Okay. Yun nga. Dahil nag-manifest ng PCGG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: They will no longer present evidence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Um, could the, uh, could the PCGG just, uh, place on the record how much of that civil case 0141, may partial recoveries,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: how much was, remained, has remained unrecovered because they said they would no longer present evidence?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: The chair would like to inform Rep. Inyo that his time has expired.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: We'll just get the exact figure po, Madam Speaker, if we could give it also or provide it to our distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So, yun po yung isang tanong. Hindi po nila mabigay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: They're just getting the numbers po, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And then, um, during the budget hearings, I asked and I have been provided with...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ah, information on the total value of the remaining pending PCGG cases for recovery of ill-gotten wealth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And here, ah, ah, the PCGG has said that there are a total of 67 pending cases pending before the Sandigan Bayan or lower courts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: With, ah, Supreme Court or CA 31, pending in foreign courts, 2, for a total of 67,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: the total monetary value of ill-gotten wealth that should be recovered amounts to 76.773 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, does the PCGG confirm that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meron pa pong 67 cases na pending na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ill-gotten wealth case na gusto pang bawiin ng gobyerno sa Pamilya Marcos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Yes, there are still 67 pending cases po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pakiklaro lang po yung on appeal with, ah, SE, SE 31.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Recently, there is a case where 7 of the, ah, corruption charges against...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ah, the former First Lady, ah, and member of the House, Imelda Marcos, was dismissed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ibig po ba sabihin, babawasan, yung 67, babawasan ng 7?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ah, Madam Speaker, hindi po kasama yun sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Um, let, I will wrap up then, ah, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, the PCG, para rin ma-place on the record yung accomplishments ng PCGG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meron pong binanggit dito na tatlong, ah, dalawa pala, na significant recent, ah, victories or accomplishments of PCGG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Para huwag naman po isipin na walang ginagawa ang, wala nang ginagawa ang PCGG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Na ipanalo raw yung kaso kaugnay sa Malacanang of the North, in Paway, Ilocos Norte.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, in other words, nagrulang Supreme Court na pag-aari ng gobyerno, hindi ng, ah, Pamilya Marcos, yung, ah, 576,000 square meters of, ah, the Malacanang of the North.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: The Chair would like to inform again, Representative Pino, that his time has expired.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Last na po, last na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nanalo din po sa Supreme Court kaugnay sa Payanig sa Pasig Property.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Again, ruling that this is property of the government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: These victories affirm the Republic's ownership and control over significant properties, more or less 50 billion in value.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, napakahalaga po na panalo na hindi ito sa Pamilya Marcos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kung hindi, sa gobyerno ng Pilipinas, 50 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, however, meron pang 76 billion na hinahabol.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ah, with that, Madam Speaker, ah, ubos na po ang aking oras.

segments.text: Thank you, Representative Tinio, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Vice Chair Josefina B. Taliado from the 1st District of Camarines Norte to sponsor the budget of the PRA.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Representative Josefina Taliado, Vice Chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations, is hereby recognized to sponsor the budget of the Philippine Reclamation Authority.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: I rise today to present for the consideration of this august chamber,

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: the proposed 5 billion budgetary support for the Philippine Reclamation Authority for Fiscal Year 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Intended for the continued implementation of the Philippine International Exhibition Center, PIEC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: PRA is the government instrumentality mandated not only to regulate and undertake reclamation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: infrastructure development and the development and management of public estate in the national interest.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: In furtherance of this mandate, the PIEC is envisioned as a national flagship infrastructure project

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: that will strengthen the country's capacity to host major international meetings,

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: conventions, and exhibitions, support tourism, and related industries,

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: and enhance the productive use and value of government-owned properties in the area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: With this, Madam Speaker, I am ready for the interpellation and in advance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: I thank our distinguished colleagues for their consideration and support

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: proposed budget of the Philippine Reclamation Authority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to recognize the Honorable Presley de Jesus to interpellate the sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Representative Presley de Jesus of [unclear] is hereby recognized for his interpellation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Speaker, and to the distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The 5 billion Philippine International Exhibition Center allocation

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: provides the Philippine Reclamation Authority with 5 billion pesos

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: for the Philippine International Exhibition Center, or PIEC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: This is a substantial new appropriation for a government-owned or controlled corporation

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: that ordinarily undertakes proprietary and revenue-generating activities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Why is an additional 5 billion in national government support

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: being coursed through the PRA for the PIEC

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: considering that the project is being implemented

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: by the Department of Public Works and Highways

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: for the Office of the President?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ang unang dalawang SARO po kasi ng project ay

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: nanggaling na sa Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: dahil sila ang mas higit na nakakaalam sa implementation ng proyekto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Kaya po, nararapat lang na ang DPWH ang mag-implement ng project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Madam Speaker, my follow-up question is, what is the precise financial responsibility of the PRA, the Department of Public Works and Highways, and the Office of the President for the project?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And which entity will own, operate, maintain, and receive revenues from the completed facility?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Your Honor, PRA handles the government asset and project side, while DPWH handles the procurement, design, and construction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ang project naman po ay para sa nasyonal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Government under the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: At ito po ay sinama sa list of infrastructure project, flagship project ng pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Kapag natapos na po ang PIEC, pangangasiwaan po ito ng PRA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: So, ang revenue po na makukuha dito ay makakadagdag

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: sa dibidendo na ibinibigay ng PRA sa pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in short, Madam Speaker, once the project has been completed, PRA na po ang magpapatakbo. Tama ho ba yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Next, what alternative financing arrangements including PRA corporate funds, land development, revenues, borrowings, or private participation were evaluated before additional national government funding was sought?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Pinag-aralang mabuti bago po kayo humingi ng national government funding?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ah, yes po. Ito po ay pinag-aralang mabuti bago po kami humingi ng pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ayon po kasi sa CAVCOM approval, NEDA board confirmation at RDC approval, ang national government ang gagastos ng project cost.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: At ang PRA naman, ang contribution niya ay yung lupa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Okay. What return, whether through revenue, employment, tourism receipts, or appreciation of public land, should taxpayers expect from this investment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ang financial and economic benefits po ay evaluated ng NEDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ah, 1.33 trillion pesos, absolute peso value of total net economic benefits over 50 years based on conservative assumption.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: And 377.7 billion pesos, absolute peso value of total net financial benefit over 50 years based on conservative assumptions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, Madam Speaker, if the PIEC eventually generates a profit, will the national government recover its 5 billion contribution before revenues are retained?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Or distributed elsewhere? Ito po ba ibabalik sa gobyerno o i-dedistribute po sa iba-ibang departamento?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Which particular department po or agencies ang makikinabang dito once na-recover po itong 5 billion contribution ng national government?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Siyempre po, ang makikinabang dito, ang ating unang-una, ang BIR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Kasi, siyempre, yung papasok na profit sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: And ikalawa po, inaasahang lilikha ito ng trabaho, negosyo para sa mga, especially yung sa mga hotels po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Of course, pag may convention, so yun po ang papasok na income sa gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ang turismo sa Pilipinas, dahil tayo po ay, alam natin, napag-iiwanan na rin natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Napag-iiwanan na tayo kasi wala nga tayong mapagdausan ng malaking mga events sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The PIEC is reported to cost approximately 27 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And then your target will be this year, 40% lang po ang completion and the rest will be on 2027 by the end of 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ito ba yung makukumpleto natin before the end of 2027? Itong project na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Hindi pa po natin makukumpleto ang proyekto ngayong 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ang inish, ang inaasahan po natin makukumpleto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ito ang proyekto ay sa April 2028.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, my next question, what is the complete funding and implementation plan for the PIEC from initial design through construction, equipment procurement, testing, and opening?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: So, ang kalahatang pondo nga po natin is 27 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Again, it's related to my first question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What portion of the estimated 27 billion cost remains unfunded?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Magkano po yung kailangan nyo pa po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Pondo ay yung 5 billion at saka yung 10 billion para po makumpleto natin ang ating PIEC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, while phase 1 reached only 90% completion by the end of 2027, kasama doon po ba yung 5 billion na i-appropriate na?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The 5 billion additional fund, ito na po ang magtatapos o kukumpleto yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, yung phase 1 kasama yung 5 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Yung phase 2 po, yun yung magtatapos po ng ating construction building, yung PIEC ng 10 billion pa po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Pinaktor na po yung inflation rate, lahat po kasama na dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Pati yung dollar po natin habang ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: My next question, climate resilience of a facility built on a reclaimed land.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kasi ito po lagi problema natin, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Pag the property is being reclaimed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The PIEC is being built on reclaimed land in Manila Bay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: An area exposed to typhoons, storm surge, sea level rise, land subsidence,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: A facility expected to operate for several decades must be designed for future climate conditions

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What climate and geotechnical standards were used in designing the PIEC and its reclaimed site?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ito po kasi nagiging problema ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Pag ano, sa Japan nga po, yung airport nila, every year po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: We're talking about 27 billion plus 10 billion pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kung sakali po lumabog to or magka-problema.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Alam niyo po, ang ating bansa, tayo po yung pinakapaborito ng mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Lagi nilang every year, not less than 20 typhoons na dumatid po sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Kasi po, pinag-aralan natin, pinag-aralan ito.

segments.text: Your Honor, depende po yun sa ECC kung papayagan nilang ma-extend.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So, halimbawa po itong sampu na ito, hanggang kailan po natin naasahan na po pwede silang makakomply doon sa requirement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ang live po ng ECC ay five years. So, after five years po at hindi pa sila nakapag-comply, pwede po silang i-apply for extension, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Napakahalaga po kasi itong suspension na binanggit originally ng Presidente, which was eventually lifted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasi meron ding apat na malalaking kumpanya na natanggalan din ng suspension at nag-proceed yung kanilang mga proyekto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At sa panahon po ngayon na tumitingin talaga ang pagbaha sa Metro Manila at karating pong mga probinsya natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: talaga pong isa sa tinitingnan ng ating mga kababayan na maaaring dahilan kung bakit ang baha ay hindi ganun kabilis mawala tulad dati na pagbumaha after a few hours

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: or matagal na yung a few days ay bababa dahil po sa nangyayari yung mga developments na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ang tanong po natin ay, how can dredging and reclamation affect the worsening of flooding episodes in the country, particularly in NCR and our nearby provinces?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Kaya nga po, nire-require namin na subject po ay for hydrodynamic modeling, flooding studies, and hydraulic studies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So ito pong studies na ito, sino po ang nagko-commission?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sino po ang nagko-commission sa UP?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sige po, mukhang mahalaga po na sa sitwasyon po natin ngayon, hindi dapat sapat na mayroon lamang study na kinomission yung proponent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: The PRA should exercise due diligence in ensuring na ito po ay hindi makaka-apekto sa pagpapalala lalo ng baha sa Metro Manila at mga karating na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Yung sumunod ko naman po ang tanong, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker, ay paano po ang coastal defense ng mga reclaimed areas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasi po sila na ngayon yung bago na nasa coast natin. So ano po ang coastal defense mechanisms na mayroon, kung mayroon man, itong mga proyektong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasi baka po sa dulo, sila naman yung susunod na maging problema natin pagdating ng mga storm surge mula po sa area na yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ah dati po kasi ang seawall natin ay 3 meters lang. So ngayon po, ginawa na po natin siyang 7 meters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So sino po ang magkoconstruct ng seawall dito po sa mga reclaimed areas na ito? Sino po ang gagastos?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Yung proponent na po, kasi po part po ito ng project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kumusta po yung compliance nila dito po sa provision na ito ng kontrata?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: And well, monitored po yun, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor, may request the PRA to submit a report on the compliance on the coastal defense measures that are installed or are being implemented by the proponents of the project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: I cannot overemphasize yung fear ng mga kababayan natin sa lumalalang pagbaha na naranasan natin ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maaring patikim pa lang ito nangyayari sa atin at alam natin na isa sa tinitindahan ng ating mga kababayan ay mga pagkarami-raming reclamation projects na nangyayari sa Manila Bay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kailangan natin suriin ang kaugnayan ng mga reclamation projects sa lumalalang pagbaha sa Metro Manila at mga karating na probinsya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: We need a comprehensive approach to flood mitigation and management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa mga reclamation projects na walang maayos na impact assessment sa flooding sa mga komunidad at walang proper drainage.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nakababahala na ang total approved reclamation projects sa Manila Bay, 13 in total ay around 5,000 hectares or about 8% of the total land area of the National Capital Region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero hanggang sa ngayon, wala tayong nakikita maayos na integration program para ting sa flood management between these projects and the LGUs around the Manila Bay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Speaker, gusto po natin magpasalamat sa ating butihing sponsor at sana po ay makapag-comply ang PRA doon po sa nire-request natin ng mga dokumento.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to recognize the Honorable Sarah Jane Elago to interpolate the sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Representative Sarah Jane Elago of Gabriela Women's Party List is hereby recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker. Sundan ko lang po yung nabuksan na usapin ng ating kasamahan tungkol sa reclamation sa Manila Bay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ito po ay tungkol doon sa na-aprobahan na na dalawang reclamation projects sa Pasay City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sang-ayon sa statement ng PRA noong November 24, 2023, pagkatapos ng rigorous evaluation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: nakasama ang DENR, ang mga proyektong ito ay nag-adhere na sa mga kondisyon na sinet para sa Environmental Compliance Certificate at Area Clearance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang dalawang proyektong ito ay ang 265-hectare Pasay Harbor City Reclamation Project ng Pasay Harbor City Corporation

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at ang 360-hectare Pasay Reclamation Project ng SM Prime Holdings.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Buong 5 billion peso budget ng PRA para sa 2027 ay nakalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para sa MOOE ng Philippine International Exhibition Center na matatagpuan sa 265-hectare na Pasay Harbor City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang katanungan ko po, Madam Speaker, sa kabila po ng naisagawang cumulative impact assessment sa Manila Bay reclamation

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na mayroong matinding epekto sa kabuhayan ng mga manging isda, water circulation, traffic management at pagbaha,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: bakit po ba ipinagpapatuloy pa rin ng PRA ang mga proyektong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Your Honor, yung mga nabanggit po na pinayagan magpatuloy matapos ang compliance review ay ang 265-hectare Pasay City Harbor and Development Project

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: ay pinayagang mag-resume noong 2023 matapos ang DNR compliance review.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Na nag-kumpirma ng kanilang compliance sa kanilang Environmental Compliance Certificates or ECCs, area clearance at mga requirements ng PRA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Gayunman, ang kanilang pagpapatuloy ay mananatiling subject sa continuing monitoring at sa risulta ng cumulative impact assessment ng DNR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: And mahalaga pong banggitin na sa Pasay 360, binago mismo ang configuration ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: reclamation upang magkaroon ng mas malawak na water channel sa pagitan ng mainland at reclaim island. Ang unang redesign po ay naglaan ng 300-meter channel at pagkatapos ay pinalawak

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: patungo humigit-kumulang 476 meters bilang bahagi ng mga hakbang upang tugunan ang hydrodynamic at flooding

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: concerns. Sa katunayan po, may bahagi ng dating reclaim na kinakailangang alisin o i-rehandle upang makagawa ng mas malawak na channel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Josefina B. Tallado
segments.text: Ito nga po ay yung sa area sa tapat ng dating Sofitel Hotel. Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat Madam Speaker. Nabanggit nga ako na kung sa papel naman pagdating sa mga requirements,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na punan ito, na isumiti ito, na aprobahan. Ngunit ang nakita rin po natin sa deliberasyon dito sa plenaryo, halimbawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at dun sa mga naging budget briefings sa lahat po ng mga issues na may kinalaman sa Manila Bay Clean Up, sa Manila Bay Reclamation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at sa panawagan natin ng Manila Bay Rehabilitation, ay wala pong particular na programa na sapat para matugunan yung impact

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa lahat po ng mga nakasalalay, ang kanilang kabuhayan, hindi lang po sa particular area na ito, pero dun sa buong Manila Bay mismo, marami na pong mga pag-aaral ang tungkol sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Matindi na epekto nito sa ating mga fisherfolk, asang-ayon po sa pamalakaya na wala na po ang kanilang over 80% ng kanilang daily income dahil daw po sa mga reclamation projects na nasira na ang mga major fishing grounds, ang fish habitats, kabilang na ang mangroves, coral areas at seagrasses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron din pong statement ang Oceana na grupo tungkol sa matagal ng nakakabahala ng mga reclamation projects na nakakaabala sa natural na daloy ng tubig dahil hinaharangan ng mga ito ang daluya ng tubig na dapat sana ay umaagos patungo sa dagat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya naman dahil dyan, Madam Speaker, hamon po ito sa ating kapulungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung ganitong may mga issue na may kinalaman sa kalagayan ng ating mga magsasaka, may ganitong mga concerns na pinapahatid ang ating civil society, nararapat lamang nadingginan natin yung iba't ibang panukalang resolusyon dito sa House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Isa na dyan ang resolusyon para maimbestigahan ang mga reclamation projects na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang House Bill No. 6270 na nag-aasam, nangangarap, nananawagan na maideklara na ang Manila Bay bilang reclamation free zone.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Layunin din po nito na matiyak na magiging mahigpit yung ating mga pamantayan at mapreserba din ang ating mga yamang dagat sa buong bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yun lamang sa ngayon, Madam Speaker. Maraming salamat sa ating distinguished guests.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished members of the House of Representatives, ladies and gentlemen, I rise to sponsor the proposed budget of the Department of Migrant Workers, including its attached agency the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration or OWWA, for fiscal year 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: amounting to an expenditure of 10.68 billion. Since its establishment in 2022, the DMW has stayed true to its mandate to protect the rights, preserve the dignity, and promote the welfare of more than 2.2 million overseas Filipino workers across the globe. They serve as a tahanan for our OFWs, whose remittances reached

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: a record of US$35.63 billion in 2025, accounting for 8% of our national GDP. The DMW commitment to our OFWs manifests through its key programs and welfare initiatives, such as legal, medical, and other assistance through the Aksyon Fund, repatriation assistance through the OWWA Emergency Repatriation Fund,

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: specialized medical care through the OFW Hospital, national reintegration services, anti-illegal recruitment and anti-trafficking operations, and maritime research and skills services, among many others. Knowing the significant economic contributions of OFWs and this government's obligation to protect their rights and welfare along the global volatility and evolving geopolitical

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: realities they are facing, it is imperative for this Congress to equip the DMW with the capacity to deliver its call to provide agile and responsive service befitting the hard work and sacrifice of each OFW and their families. And so, Madam Speaker, we solicit your kind support for the swift approval of the budget of the DMW and attached agency for fiscal year 2027.

segments.text: Who were detained before deportation that when they called the Philippine Embassy to the US,

segments.text: the response was, okay lang yan, makakalaya ka naman, diba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Does DMW share the same opinion?

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, currently po tinatrabaho po ito ng DMW

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: para po ma-make sure, or coordinated with, of course, the Manning Agency

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: para po meron pang, merong legal assistance po, supports pa lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Yun po ang aksyon na ginagawa ng DMW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat at naniniwala ako sa DMW na ito'y tutugunan nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kasi currently, nasa mahigit dalawang daang seafarers na po ang nagkaroon ng ganitong problema.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yung tinatawag nilang operational tidal wave.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kamakailan ay naglabas na po sila ng kanilang press release patungkol dito sa nangyari sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kasi wala po eh, walang nagre-report, hindi po ito lumalabas sa media.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At ang masaklap pa, sasabihan po sila ng ating embahada na nasa US na,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: okay lang yan, makakalaya ka naman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Umalis ako ng aking bansa, pupunta ako para maging isang seafarer,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: malalaman ko na lang na ako'y ipapababa at ako'y ipapadeport,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: pero idedetain pa ako at popusasan pa ako ng ilang oras, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So, sana po ay matugunan po natin ito sa lalong madaling panahon, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor, magkano po kaya ang na-dispersed na mula sa Action Fund

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: para sa mga Pilipinong biktima ng mass deportations na walang due process?

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, so far 222 seafarers have been deported

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: and each were given 50,000 pesos in financial assistance under the Action Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: So, total po, 11.1 million po ang na-dispersed galing sa Action Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: My office also received reports that there are instances wherein six months since the seafarer has returned to the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: hindi pa rin narirelease ang Action Fund sa nasabing seafarers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Madam Sponsor, what is the reason kaya behind this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, again, the reasoning behind the delay is because of the Middle East tensions

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: and unfortunately po yun ang nag-cause ng delay but right now, DMW is catching up

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: and we're committed to going back to the 30-day disbursement po ng assistance for our OFWs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Just to put into record lang, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor, can the DMW commit to ensure

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: the expedient release of, or hindi lalagpas ng 30 days from today po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And finally, can the Distinguished Sponsor explain to us po, ano itong tinatawag nilang Abu Dhabi Dialogue at bakit ito mahalaga?

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, the Abu Dhabi Dialogue was established in 2028

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: at ito po ay isang voluntary inter-government consultative forum

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: linking Asian countries of labor origin and destination

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: and it aims to enable safe, orderly, and regular migration. Currently po, mayroon po siyang 10 member states including the Gulf States po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At magkano po kaya ang nakalaan pondo para dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, currently wala po siyang allotment sa NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: That's why nag-manifest po ang DMW ng kanilang request for 60 million pesos po

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: to host at least three conferences po para sa Abu Dhabi Dialogue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And ang Pilipinas ang host po para dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kakalungkot no na host pa naman tayo pero wala tayong pondo para dito at napaka-importante po pala nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sinusuportahan ng representasyong ito ang paglalaan ng pondo para sa Abu Dhabi Dialogue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mahalaga ang pondong ito upang maipagpatuloy ang mga programa para sa pagsasanay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: proteksyon at mas maayos na kapakanan ng ating mga OFWs at iba pang migrant workers sa Middle East.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And in closing, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor, thank you for yielding into my questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nais kong muling ipahayag ang aking panawagan noong budget briefing na sa gitna ng umiiral na global conflict,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: mas higit nating kailangan ang matatag na DMW at OWA na may sapat na pondo upang matugunan ang pangangailangan ng ating mga overseas Filipino workers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I express my strong support for increasing the budget of the DMW and OWA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: particularly with the repatriation program and assistance programs to distressed OFWs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: with the guarantee na masiguro ng DMW ang mabilis, maayos at sapat na tulong sa ating mga kababayang OFWs sa oras ng pangangailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nakikita natin ang epekto pag nagagawa ng isang ahensya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang kanilang mandato, which is evident sa mga nagagawa ng ating DMW Region 9,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: gaya ng pagtatayo ng First Regional OFW Airport Lounge outside na IA at First Regional Dedicated OFW Ward na sana ay magawa rin sa iba pang mga regyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Naniniwala ako na sa gabay at tinig ng ating distinguished sponsor, this August Chamber will favorably...

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: consider and strengthen the department's budget, particularly for these vital programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Speaker. Maraming salamat, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move that we recognize Honorable Iris Montes, 4K Partylist, to interpelate on the proposed budget of the DMW.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Honorable Montes is recognized for her interpelation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ilang katanungan lamang po mula sa kababaihan, kabalikatan para sa kapakanan at kaunlaran ng bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Women consistently account for the majority of newly deployed land-based overseas Filipino workers,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: predominantly in domestic care work, a sector inherently prone to isolation, abuse, and labor exploitation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: how much of the agarang kalinga at saklolo para sa mga OFW na nangangailangan or action fund is explicitly sub-allocated

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: for immediate legal intervention, medical treatment, and physical rescue of abused female domestic workers?

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, as of now po, ang action fund ay ready po na ma-

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: The entire fund is ready to be used for any cases para po sa kahit sinong OFW na nangangailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: So far po, over 50% ay actually nabigay po para sa ating mga kababaihan na OFWs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: 50% po yung halos ang naibigay mo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: More than. Kasi mas marami nga po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: I remember during the last budget hearing, I specifically requested po talaga sa DMW to have a sex disaggregated data.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Isa po yan sa concern ko na talagang dapat ma-disaggregate yung data para alam po natin at magkano din po ang ilalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kasi marami po talaga sila para natutugunan po natin yung pangangailangan nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: My next question po, under RA 9710.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: or the Magna Carta of Women, government agencies are required to protect women in specially difficult circumstances.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Out of the total operational budget of the migrant workers' offices and runaway shelters overseas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: what specific line item is allocated to ensure that these shelters have trauma-informed female personnel,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Siguro po, kahit including mga gender-sensitive professionals din po, like yung mga gynecologists and the like.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: or specific line item po ay ang ating Migrant Workers Resource Centers at ang ating Labor Attachés Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Uso po ngayon, ang dami po ngayong mga digital job scams and human trafficking rings continue to target young, vulnerable women,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: especially in rural areas, ano, for illegal placement in cyber fraud hubs across Southeast Asia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ano po, meron po, bawat direct budget allocation is set aside in the 2027 budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: under the Illegal Recruitment Combat Directorates to expand anti-trafficking law enforcement and digital monitoring down to the LGU level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: so far po, para po sa mga illegal recruitment, meron po tayong 18 million po na pondo na nakalaan po para dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: 18 million lamang po ang pondo para dyan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Isang napakalaking problema po meron tayo ngayon tungkol dyan sa mga digital job scams na yan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: tapos 18 million lang po ang nakalaan na pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Siguro dapat po ay mahiling po natin na madagdagan po ang pondong iyan kasi napakalaki po ng hinaharap na problema ngayon ng DMW din tungkol dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Yes po, kaya po kasama rin po sa manifestation ng DMW,

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: ang additional funding po na hiningi nila for 2 billion pesos ay syempre po parte po ng mailalaan po para sa legal recruitment and illegal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: A major driver of repeated migration cycles among women is the absence of viable domestic economic opportunities upon returning home.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kaya nga po sila umaalis din dahil kulang dun sa economic opportunities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ganun din po, pagbalik, ganun pa rin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Under the DMW and Overseas Workers' Welfare Administration Joint Reintegration,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: budget for 2027, ano po ang proportion, what proportion of funds is directly earmarked for high-value skills training,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: siguro po sa technology, healthcare, specialization, kasi yun po ang medyo mas malaki ang demand sa ating mga returning female OFWs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Para po sa Balik Pinay Program, 45 million pesos po ang nakalaan para dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: At it's also worth mentioning po siguro na ang ating ERF or Emergency Repatriation Fund,

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: 79% po nito ay nalaan para po sa kababaihan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: So that's over 1 billion po na pondo na naiilaan po para sa kababaihan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Pag-huling katanungan na lamang po, ano?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: What quantifiable indicators and gender disaggregated baseline data

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: does the DMW use in the 2027 budget proposal

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: successfully transition out of precarious low-wage care work

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: into sustainable domestic livelihoods or formal employment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: meron po ng budget ng DMW every year ay nakalaan po para sa monitoring services

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: para po makita natin kung saan po ba or enough po ba ang nalalaan para sa ating mga kababaihan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: At meron din po tayong disaggregated data tungkol dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Sorry, I have the data here.

segments.text: For the Balikpinay Balikhanap Buhay Program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sa panghuli, payagan niyo po akong ipahayag na alam naman po natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ang contribution ng ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Hindi natin po matatawaran ang ambag nila sa ating bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sila ang bumubuhay ng ating ekonomiya sa pamamagitan ng kanilang remittances.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sila ang nagdadala ng dangal ng Pilipino sa iba't ibang lugar or panig ng mundo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: At sila rin ang nagbabayad ng pinakamataas na halaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ang pagkakahiwalay sa pamilya at ang panganib sa kanilang kaligtasan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kaya naman nararapat na ang Department of Migrant Workers ay bigyan ng mas mataas na pondo

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: upang matiyak na ang proteksyon, suporta at reintegrasyon ng ating mga OFWs ay tunay na maisa sa katuparan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sa bawat pisong ilalaan sa DMW, nakataya ang buhay at kinabukasan ng milyong-milyong Pilipino

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kaya't hinihiling natin na ang 2027 budget ng DMW ay palakasin upang ang kanilang sakripisyo ay masuklian

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ng mas matibay na proteksyon, mas maayos na serbisyo at mas makabuluhang suporta mula sa pamahalaan.

segments.text: Thank you, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.text: Madam Speaker, yes, since most ancestral domains and ICCs/IPs are located in the regions, we recognize that NCIP's capacity must also be strongest at the field level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: For 2027, our direction is to strengthen our regional, provincial, and community service centers by providing the necessary technical personnel, field resources, and operational support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: Marami po sa trabaho ng NCIP ay ginagawa mismo sa communities.
