segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: This requires our personnel to actually reach the communities, including those in geographically isolated and disadvantaged areas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: So, strengthening the field offices is not simply an administrative investment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: To deliver the mandate of NCIP, where our ICCs, IPs, actually are.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: The NCIP will deliver what is funded while continuing to present the remaining requirements so that, over time, it can address the larger backlog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: CAGTI and CALTI processing is the legal recognition of ancestral domain and ancestral land rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: It is not an ordinary process.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: It is not an ordinary permit or simple administrative transactions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: Ang kinikilala po natin dito ay karapatan sa lupa na may intergenerational consequences.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: Once recognized, it affects not only the present generation but also the generations that will come after them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: That is why the process has to be thorough and evidence-based.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: It involves community participation, genealogical and historical research, census, survey and mapping, validation, resolution of boundary and overlapping claims, legal review, and ultimately, commission deliberations.

segments.text: Local indigenous groups were manipulated amid a clan power struggle.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Joboy" S. Aquino II
segments.text: Dating back to 2020, weaponizing a sacred cultural observance for political gain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Joboy" S. Aquino II

segments.text: NCIP certification and endorsement issued March 2021 by NCIP Region 3.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: May hawak din po tayong dokumento eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: Hindi po covered ng CADT ang Santa Lucia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ito nga po, yung application na ito, yun po ang coverage. Pero sinasabi ninyo, hindi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, nag-amend. So, ano, inalis na po yung Santa Lucia?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, okay. Anyway, pero yung mga ibang ito ay may application. Tama po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pahagi. Ano po ang status ng application?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: The claim remains under processing due to overlapping claims with BCDA titled areas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: Funding requirement for CADT processing, incomplete supporting evidence, requiring further validation, and internal community issues that need to be resolved.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So, may mga issues pa po. So, may conflicting claims ang grupo ng ITA na ito with BCDA itself. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tapos may mga iba pang issue na binanggit kayo. Tama po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero ngayon, yung subject na, yung gusto nilang, yung ina-applyan nila, yun mismo, yung area na sasaklawin ng Paxilica Project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: O, yun na nga. Kahit yung Santa Lucia, yung sinasabi nyo, merong ibang application eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: Ang tinanggal po yung mga residential areas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Opo. Pero ang point po natin, meron po mga ITA dyan. At maaring sabihin, eh wala pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pending pa yung CADT application nila. In the meantime, pinapaalis na nga po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ayun na nga eh. Bebinasa ako kanina na sulat ng BCDA. Sabi, punta ka dito sa opisina, pag-usapan natin yung tulong na ibibigay sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meaning, bibigyan ka na lang ng relocation fee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, paano po tayo ngayon? Paano ngayon yung mga IP na nandyan? Tandaan po natin, ang mga nandyan po, mga ITA, according to historical and genetic records, talagang isa sa mga unang,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: unang inhabitants ng kapuluan. Di po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: Wala po. Wala pong information ang NCIP. Ang nakakaalam po diyan ay ang BCDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Wala, sorry po. Wala pong information?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, wala pong ano? Pakiulit lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rodolfo "Ompong" M. Ordanes
segments.text: Ang nakakasagot po dyan ay ang BCDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Well, ang mungkahi po natin, dahil sabi nyo, meron kayo kaninang commitment na itindigan nyo yung karapatan ng mga IP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: yung mungkahi po natin ay puntahan nyo na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dahil, ayun na nga po, yung mga IP na ito mismo, yung mga nag-apply,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: no, pabanggitin ko na po yung pangalan, nung kanilang chieftain ang tawag po nila dyan eh,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: si Apong Pet, ayan, nakikita ko po. Kilala po ba yan ng NCIP?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Opo. Ayan, si Chieftain Petronila C. Mu?oz, CADT representative, no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Eh, sila po, no, ang pinagkukuna natin ng informasyon, no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, well, kasama po sila sa dialog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kasama sa dialog. Kaya nga po, at kasama rin sila sa mga nangunguna sa pagprotesta,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: kontra sa Paxilica Project at, ayan na nga, sa mga ginagawang panggigipit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: No, yung sinasabi nila, kahit yung access, yung mga access roads sa kanilang mga community,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: minsan hinaharangan, and so on, hindi na madaling makapasok, no,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang mga naisumuporta sa kanilang laban dahil naghihigpit na po ang BCDA, yung New Clark City, dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: No, so, Mr. Speaker, alam ko, tapos na po ang oras natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, hinahighlight lang po natin dito, no, na may direktang banta,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang Paxilica Project sa karapatan ng mga IP dahil ang unang-unang tatargetin ay critical minerals areas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: meaning yung mga lupain mismo ng mga indigenous peoples.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At kahit nga, sa kaso ng New Clark City, hindi naman daw minahan ito, pero malinaw na mga IP communities din,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: particular sa mga barangay at sityo na nabanggit natin, ang direktang maapektuhan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Honorable Tinio, with your indulgence, your time has expired.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, kaya po, yan po ang hamon natin at binabantayan po natin ang NCIP sa isyong ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi tayo, hindi natin tatanggapin na ang mangyari pa ang NCIP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: magfafacilitate at magra-rubber stamp sa nais ng U.S. at ng gobyerno Marcos na pabilisin

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang pagbubukas at pagmimina sa mga lupain natin, lalo na sa mga lupang ninuno, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, Honorable Tinio, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Rene Co for her manifestation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: The Honorable Rene Co is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Speaker, at magandang gabi po sa ating butihing sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, manifestasyon na lang po ang ihahain ng representasyong ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Bago po magtapos ang pag-uusap tungkol sa budget ng NCIP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa katotohanan, Mr. Speaker, hindi po maganda ang mga napakaraming reports na nakuha natin sa mga indigenous communities

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na nakakaranas ng harassment sa mga large mining companies dahil po sa mga itinatayo doon gustong protektahan ng ating mga katutubo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yung kanilang mga lupain, yung kalikasan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero dahas at even lawfare yung hinaharap sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang ilan pong mga nakikita nating mga kaso ay yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na in-issue ang NCIP na hanggang

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ngayon ay kinokontest po nila ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: galing sa mga residente ng Bulalakaw

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: activities ng Crescent Mining and Development

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sila rin po ay may pending na

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yung kaso ng mga indigenous peoples

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: sa Dupaks del Norte, Nueva Vizcaya

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: at sila po in particular ay

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: mas aggrieved dahil sila po ay mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: katutubo na galing po sa mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: sa Nueva Vizcaya dahil po sa mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: wala pong recurso tuloy silang mapuntahan

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So hanggang ngayon po, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: pero dahil natanong na rin po

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: for now, I'd just like to note

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: I move to terminate the period

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: For the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples
